section_role: abstract, contributions, related work, method overview

method_evidence.claim: CubiD performs masked prediction across both spatial and dimensional axes simultaneously.
method_evidence.anchor: We propose Cubic Discrete Diffusion (CubiD), which performs masked prediction across both spatial and dimensional axes simultaneously.

method_evidence.claim: CubiD treats the h × w × d tensor as a unified space with fine-grained masking.
method_evidence.anchor: treating the h × w × d tensor as a unified space with fine-grained masking

method_evidence.claim: Dimension-wise quantization discretizes continuous high-dimensional features.
method_evidence.anchor: dimension-wise quantization that enables tractable discretization

experiment_evidence.claim: CubiD achieves 1.88 FID on ImageNet 256x256 with 768-dimensional discrete tokens.
